core_obligations: Statement (lines 2073-2085): the rule U'_m = union over phi: [m] -> [i], i <= n, of the images of U(phi) defines a subsimplicial set U' of U with U'_i = U_i for i <= n, and all m-simplices of U' are degenerate for m > n.

Verification (proof lines 2087-2094): if x = U(phi)(y) with y in U_i, i <= n, then U(psi)(x) = U(phi psi)(y) with phi psi: [m'] -> [i], so U' is stable under the simplicial operators; U'_i = U_i for i <= n is witnessed by phi = id; and a simplex coming from degree i <= n < m is the image of a non-injective map of Delta, hence degenerate.
proof_roadmap: Check stability of the union under all simplicial operators.
Verify equality in low degrees through the identity maps.
Unroll degeneracy in high degrees via the factorization of non-injective maps.
difficulty_reason: Generated subobject (statement 2073-2085, proof 2087-2094): stability is verified explicitly; the high-degree degeneracy claim is the one-line factorization of a non-injective Delta map through a degeneracy (the algorithm of Lemma lemma-face-degeneracy), nameable and recorded in notes. H3.
